bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
n=deploy-gaybbs-1
files=$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$n")
wd=$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}' "$n")
svc=$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}' "$n")
old=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$n")
test "$svc" = gaybbs || exit 62
test -f "$files" && test -d "$wd" || exit 63
case "$old" in *:* ) :;; *) exit 64;; esac
new=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-layout-20261111
docker image inspect "$new" >/dev/null
newid=$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$new")
oldid=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$n")
docker image tag "$oldid" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-room-layout-20261111
docker image tag "$new" "$old"
rollback() {
 docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-room-layout-20261111 "$old"
 docker compose -f "$files" --project-directory "$wd" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/tmp/gace-roompos-rollback.log 2>&1 || true
}
if ! docker compose -f "$files" --project-directory "$wd" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/tmp/gace-roompos-deploy.log 2>&1; then rollback; exit 71; fi
actual=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$n" 2>/dev/null || true)
running=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n" 2>/dev/null || true)
if test "$actual" != "$newid" || test "$running" != true; then rollback; exit 72; fi
echo GAYBBS_SINGLE_SERVICE_DEPLOY_READBACK_PASS
